{{Quote|Hello, all channels, anyone aboard Cartel research station Creataa-V please respond. This is Patla Soo, on Caarimon. Is anyone up there?|[[Patla Soo]]|<ref name="Belly of the Beaast">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref>}}
'''Creautaa-V''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]], which was used by the [[Metatheran Cartel]] as a research facility. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Believers]]&mdash;a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;plotted to release a [[Anti-Caarite virus|deadly virus]] on Caarimon, to wipe out the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Melo Centris]] and a team of Believers led by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Crymsin Ost]] landed on Creautaa-V and released the virus on the station, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all of the research facility's crew. The Believers then attempted to send some [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] containing samples of the virus down to the planet below, to infect the world. Howver, a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] boarded the space station and confronted the Believers, preventing the virus from being released onto Caarimon.
